description: Shadowbun default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/shadowbun-character-sheet.webp (intake.json swatch chips + direct samples of the drawn surfaces; the sheet's labels sit one row off their chips, mapped by colour per the 2026-10-09 binding reading). Black fur, accent gray-lavender ears, lighter lavender belly + tail, white eye dots + cloud grin. Glow (artist B3, 2026-10-09 'can add a small glow'): ONLY the eye + grin emit, a low tier (emission_scale 0.4, value well under the 2.0 phone cap); every other region is zero Glow. Alternate colours: later (artist).
